What they tried:

- Sending full page of KB context in prompt (1.5-2k tokens) each request -> increased latency and cost.

SE observations / immediate recommendations given:

- Prompt engineering: move large KB context to embeddings + local retrieval; send short (200-400 token) context windows. Use reranking on top-5 doc candidates instead of full dump.
- Batching/caching: enable prefix/KV cache (Redwood Optimize suggestion) for repeated system prompts and conversation history to cut token generation time.
- Retries/backoff: implement exponential backoff (100ms -> 500ms) for 429/503 and avoid immediate client-side hard fails.
- Token caps: enforce max_tokens per request (300) and truncate user messages older than 10 turns to reduce sequence length.
